2609.06590.title: Layer-Wise Gate-Controlled Prompt Truncation in a Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classifier
2609.06590.paper_summary: Mixture of Prompt Experts (MoPE) adapts multimodal transformers through input-dependent prompt composition, while retaining a fixed prompt length. We investigate a layer-wise gating extension in a binary chest X-ray classification pilot study. The controller predicts a retention ratio for each sample, averages these ratios within a mini-batch, and uses the resulting integer length to truncate the static and mixed visual prompts. Retained mixed prompts are also scaled by the individual ratios. In one recorded run per configuration, the gated model reached a best validation accuracy of 0.8996, compared with 0.8969 for the fixed-length baseline; the corresponding final values were 0.8963 and 0.8802. The exported gate statistics imply a retained length of one at all recorded training points, relative to a configured maximum of six. This reduces the complete visual sequence from 210 to 200 tokens, but no direct runtime measurements establish an acceleration benefit. Report-derived labels, report text as input, sequential data partitioning, and the absence of repeated controlled experiments limit interpretation. The findings document prompt shortening under the configured gate penalty; they do not establish sample-specific length allocation, superiority over fixed short prompts, or clinical utility. Code is available at: https://github.com/jingtaolei/mope-dynamic-prompt-truncation.
2609.06590.paper_summary_zh: 混合提示專家（MoPE）透過依賴輸入的提示組合來調整多模態Transformer，同時保持固定的提示長度。<lb/>我們在一項二元胸部 X 光分類的初步研究中調查了一種逐層閘控擴展。<lb/>控制器為每個樣本預測保留比例，並在小批量內平均這些比例，然後使用結果的整數長度來截斷靜態和混合視覺提示。<lb/>保留的混合提示也根據個別比例進行縮放。<lb/>在每個配置的一次記錄運行中，閘控模型達到了最佳驗證準確率 0.8996，而固定長度基準為 0.8969；相應的最終值為 0.8963 和 0.8802。<lb/>導出的閘控統計顯示，在所有記錄的訓練點，相對於配置的最大值六，保留的長度為一。<lb/>這將完整的視覺序列從 210 減少到 200 個標記，但沒有直接的運行時測量顯示加速的好處。<lb/>報告衍生的標籤、報告文本作為輸入、序列數據分區以及缺乏重複的控制實驗限制了解釋。<lb/>研究結果記錄了在配置的閘控懲罰下的提示縮短；它們並未確立樣本特定的長度分配、優於固定短提示的優越性或臨床效用。<lb/>代碼可在以下鏈接獲得：https://github.com/jingtaolei/mope-dynamic-prompt-truncation。
